Harry “The Chosen One” Potter eventually goes on to become an Auror, which feels like a good choice on the surface. Until you realize it means he’s following the career path suggested to him by a Death Eater and that he works for the same government that expelled him, slandered him, attacked him with dementors, sent a toad to torture him and then asked for him to tell the public they were doing a great job!

Not only that, there are a few other careers that make WAY more sense for Harry to have pursued - today we explore all of Harry’s other Career opportunities!
